assets.source: Google Fonts webfont API (css2) — WOFF2 per-unicode-range slices, vendored into the repo by tools/fonts/vendor-google-webfonts.mjs
assets.note: Self-hosted 'IBM Plex Mono' — machine chrome (top bar, taskbar, window titles, labels, teleprinter feed). 6 faces (300/400/500/600/700 + 400 italic) x 5 latin/cyrillic subsets, declared by src/client/styles/fonts.css. Self-hosting is an acceptance item (spec-client §3 inv 10): the client makes no third-party request.
